searchText: I haven't yet, I'll finish up this week I'm not convinced it's even worth it to have a Req for ILs so not planning on adding it yet I agree. IL feels optional now. Payload is mandatory I think After some effort, I created a visualization for the new slot anatomy per the ePBS specs. I thought it will look like a monster, but it turned to be ok. You may need to zoom in to read the text. I tried to give a wholistic picture with the slot anatomy flow. Please correct me if you see any mistakes. thanks for this. - Bid selection can only happen after second 0, the validator needs to know it's canonical head. - Timeliness of the beacon block is irrelevant to PTC votes. (If beacon block is seen timely... should read "if payload envelope is seen timely.." ) - What is the last "Broadcast" in the bottom close to "End of the slot"? - Aggregation at second 6 is missing. Thank you <@755590043632140352> Don't validators gossip and broadcast the new head of the chain for the current slot at the end of slot? Or it is specifically not added here because it is unchanged from Cancun? there's no broadcast of the head of the chain. Ok, thank you. Gm. New post on ePBS bypassing relayer: https://hackmd.io/@ttsao/bypassing-relayer Common critique: relayer persistence despite ePBS. The post explains why this is the case and why it is acceptable. Highlights benefits: reduced latency, costs, processing at peak times, trust assumptions, and fault tolerance. Feedback welcome.

After some effort, I created a visualization for the new slot anatomy per the ePBS specs. 

I thought it will look like a monster, but it turned to be ok. You may need to zoom in to read the text. I tried to give a wholistic picture with the slot anatomy flow. 

Please correct me if you see any mistakes.

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content:
thanks for this. 
- Bid selection can only happen after second 0, the validator needs to know it's canonical head. 
- Timeliness of the beacon block is irrelevant to PTC votes.  (If beacon block is seen timely... should read "if payload envelope is seen timely.." )
- What is the last "Broadcast"  in the bottom close to "End of the slot"?
- Aggregation at second 6 is missing.

excerpts.content:

Or it is specifically not added here because it is unchanged from Cancun?
